scope: Static migration inventory, not runtime authority enforcement

domains.description: Campaign identity/catalog metadata, timestamps and lifecycle; no second campaign scope key.
Chapter membership, title, scene ranges and sealing lifecycle.
Character profiles, health/conditions/stats; enemy-instance health overlap remains migration debt.
Indexes, summaries, scene events, annotations, embeddings and rebuild watermarks.
Messages, streaming/swipes and pending draft lifecycle before accepted evidence.
User scene notes, pins, gallery selections and organizational annotations.
Generic executable-mod table state/proposals of unknown semantics; not automatically tracked fictional authority.
PC/NPC identity, aliases, control and legacy isPC migration.
Consequential inventory entries and ownership/location tags, including legacy mirrored fields.
Mixed model-extracted/user-edited divergence, facts, timeline and knownBy metadata; no target authority certification.
Portrait/gallery/scene-image references and disposable generated audio/image assets.
Arc ladders, progression, clocks and pressure state.
Enemy definitions, instances, encounters, resources and combat resolution; shared health is an unresolved overlap.
Accepted archive prose and corrections/deletion/rewind of that evidence.
Active narrator profile, ask-GM handoff and characterization guidance; non-fictional reference/directive data.
NPC ledger, goals, pressure, agency and lifecycle.
Shared currentPlaceId/currentFeature, on-stage membership and journey/day state; module coordinates are projections.
Ephemeral UI/session projections, errors, streaming status and map view state.
Commit/retry markers, migration ledgers, backups and restored/imported campaign file sets.
Campaign lore and world-builder drafts/reference imports, not current tracked state.
Legacy inferred relationships, witness/stance memories; distinct from future epistemic belief authority.
Rule source text/chunks and authored rules configuration.
Application provider/preset configuration, vault and local preference metadata.
Terrain/grid, routes, roads, exploration and map encounter/discovery state; not a second shared-location owner.
Operational disposable migration artifacts only; no fictional or live authority.

competitionGroups.rationale: Append, accepted text correction and rollback/delete can replace accepted evidence without a target atomic boundary.
Manual membership, sealing and load repair overlap with derived summaries in legacy files.
Extracted facts/events, user edits and read repair coexist; knownBy is not future epistemic authority.
Enemy instance health/resources and core character profiles lack verified shared identity/health ownership; mapping must precede cutover.
Manual inventory, model bookkeeping and pending proposals share mirrored inventory fields.
Manual/import/model updates, agency and pressure share legacy NPC records.
Header, model scan, user travel and worldmap can mutate shared location/journey. Coordinate projections are not a separate location owner.

Manual create/edit with source:user and model-derived post-turn merges independently replace the same legacy NPC-to-MC/NPC-to-NPC collections. Store setters are projections; the dedicated HTTP/file path is a sink, not a competing semantic owner.

forwarders.rationale: HTTP dispatch to archive lifecycle or read-only POST semantic searches; no independent semantic owner.
Backup service dispatch; no independent semantic owner.
TTS cache lookup/init/generate dispatch; no campaign-fiction ownership.
Vault lifecycle dispatch, operational settings only.
HTTP transport adapter; actual semantic producers and server sinks are separately inventoried.

nonWriters.rationale: Model transport/composition only; POST is not itself campaign persistence or semantic state mutation. Inference classification is deferred.

limitations: Recognition is syntactic, not alias/data-flow analysis. Direct object mutation, computed member calls, generated code and newly named sink wrappers can evade detection.
Only repository production source and manifests (tracked plus nonignored untracked files) are inspected. Ignored/local/external installations and native import-time side effects are unverified.
Sandbox code generated in workerPrelude is frozen by LF-normalized whole-source hash; arbitrary third-party compute source is not analyzed.
Enemy discovery is advertised by its tier entry, but enemies has no compute registration/model discovery path. Suggestion UI state is inventoried; no discovery writer is invented.
